case_title: ZIEBELL DENNIS et al VS DEMETRO CORP GEORGE BANKOVICH REFLECTIONS BAR

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY ZIEBELL DENNIS MOGYOROSSY GEORGE AS TO DEFENDANT DEMETRO CORP GEORGE BANKOVICH REFLECTIONS BAR ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-08-1991 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 07
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT DEMETRO CORP GEORGE BANKOVICH REFLECTIONS BAR

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ZIEBELL DENNIS MOGYOROSSY GEORGE IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT DEMETRO CORP GEORGE BANKOVICH REFLECTIONS BAR STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
